title: Trader Diary: BTC’s 3‑AM Mood Swing
content:
📉 76.8k: I set a $80k target, now I’m watching my stop‑loss like a Netflix cliffhanger.
🚀 3 AM: “Just one more 10×” and the coffee’s gone cold.
🤦‍♂️ Realization: My portfolio just became a rollercoaster for the squirrels.
lesson: Set a stop‑loss before you open the position – the market won’t wait for your coffee.
question: Who else’s heart rate spiked at the 3% dip? Drop your panic emojis 👇
